caveat: Computed by the real metrics pipeline, but from the synthetic scaffold table, not from store footage. Structure is real; the numbers are not.
insight: Of everyone who enters it, Ethnic loses the largest proportion to people walking straight through — a rate rather than a headcount, so a smaller section can top this list. High traffic with few stops points at the display, not the footfall: facing, lighting or price visibility.

actions.observed: 29% (about 3 in every 10) of the trips into Ethnic end without a stop -- 224 out of 768 times somebody walked in and straight back out.
actions.todo: That is a display problem, not a footfall problem. The people are already there. Change the facing, the lighting, or make the price visible from the aisle.
